title.narrative: Supply of ICT and Solar Energy Systems to Government Agencies in Bougainville, Papua New Guinea

description.narrative: Part of a Papua New Guinea programme, EU has include a component on strengthening the institutional capacity of Autonomous Bougainville Government agencies through providing ICT equipment and solar energy systems for the beneficiary agencies identified. UNOPS was selected to support and provide the ICT equipment and solar energy systems for the beneficiary agencies on behalf of the EU.
